definitions.explanation: A specific time period in history, often referring to decades (1990s, 2000s, etc.).
A person's age or the generation they belong to.

examples.japanese: 1980{年代|ねんだい}に{流行|りゅうこう}した{音楽|おんがく}。
examples.english: Music that was popular in the 1980s.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{年代|ねんだい}の{人|ひと}に{人気|にんき}がある。
この{絵|え}の{年代|ねんだい}を{調|しら}べる。
examples.english: To investigate the age of this painting.

notes:
USAGE: {年代|ねんだい} is used for historical periods (decades) and age groups.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・19XX{年代|ねんだい} (the 19XXs - decade)
・{年代|ねんだい}を{問|と}わず (regardless of age)
・{同|おな}じ{年代|ねんだい} (same generation)
・{若|わか}い{年代|ねんだい} (younger generation)
・{年代|ねんだい}{順|じゅん} (in chronological order)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{年代|ねんだい}{別|べつ} (by age group)
・{年代|ねんだい}{記|き} (chronicle)
・{年代|ねんだい}{測定|そくてい} (dating, age determination)

RELATED WORDS:
・{時代|じだい} - era, period (longer, named periods)
・{世代|せだい} - generation
・{年齢|ねんれい} - age (individual's age)
